listing.name: Virtua Fighter 2 (Virtua Fighter 2 Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Virtua Fighter 2 Recomp; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Bounded lockstep/frame/picture checks upstream. Online not yet; these checks do not establish full hardware/gameplay qualification. Only i960 CPU recompiled; Model2A board/TGP hardware still emulated. Windows/macOS/Deck packages; online not yet, independent from VF1/VF3. Upstream platforms: Windows/macOS/Steam Deck package family. i960 native compilation plus Model2A/TGP hardware model; exact Mac CPU follows docs. Original data: ArcadeModel2 VirtuaFighter2 MAME vf2.zip v2.1 own set. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
